profileNotificationPreferences_screenBod.en: That doesn't mean delivery works yet.
You'll be asked once your account is ready.
profileNotificationPreferences_screenBod.zh: 账号准备好之后会请求一次。

profileNotificationPreferences_screenBod.en: You can turn it on here once your account is in LOOP.
profileNotificationPreferences_screenBod.zh: 账号进入 LOOP 之后，可以在这里开启。

profileNotificationPreferences_screenBod.en: Notifications stay in the in-app notification list.
profileNotificationPreferences_screenBod.zh: 通知只会留在应用内的通知列表里。

profileNotificationPreferences_screenBod.en: Turn notifications back on for LOOP in system settings.
profileNotificationPreferences_screenBod.zh: 可以在系统设置里为 LOOP 重新打开通知。

profileNotificationPreferences_screenBod.en: This device registers automatically once it has one.
profileNotificationPreferences_screenBod.zh: 拿到之后这台设备会自动登记。

profileNotificationPreferences_screenBod.en: It'll try again next time you open LOOP.
profileNotificationPreferences_screenBod.zh: 下次回到 LOOP 时会再试一次。

profileNotificationPreferences_screenLau.en: Once off, you won't get consensus badge, launch review or on-chain progress notifications.
profileNotificationPreferences_screenLau.zh: 关闭后不会再收到共识勋章、发射审核结果与上链进度通知。

profileNotificationPreferences_screenNot.en: Notification settings aren't available right now
Notification settings changed on another device. Reload before editing.
profileNotificationPreferences_screenNot.zh: 通知设置已在其他设备上改动。请重新加载后再修改。
版本冲突 —— 没有覆盖任何内容

profileNotificationPreferences_screenNot.en: Push hasn't been confirmed on a real device yet. Switches still save and still affect the in-app notification list.
profileNotificationPreferences_screenNot.zh: 推送还没有在真机上确认过。开关照常保存，也照常影响站内的通知列表。

profileNotificationPreferences_screenNot.en: New messages, price alerts and security events are pushed to this device. Tap Turn on and the system asks once.
profileNotificationPreferences_screenNot.zh: 新消息、价格提醒和安全事件会推送到这台设备。点开启后，系统会询问一次。

profileNotificationPreferences_screenNot.en: {deliveringEnabledCount} on and in effect. Only price alerts create in-app notifications for now; security events are always on.
profileNotificationPreferences_screenNot.zh: {deliveringEnabledCount} 项开启并生效。目前只有价格提醒会生成应用内通知；安全事件始终开启。

profileNotificationPreferences_screenSwi.en: Once off, you won't get this type of notification.
profileNotificationPreferences_screenSwi.zh: 关闭后不会再收到这一类通知。

profileNotificationPreferences_screenTit.en: This device is registered for push
profileNotificationPreferences_screenTit.zh: 这台设备已登记接收推送

profileNotificationPreferences_screenTit.en: Notification permission hasn't been requested on this device
profileNotificationPreferences_screenTit.zh: 还没有向这台设备请求通知权限

profileNotificationPreferences_screenTit.en: No push channel on this device
profileNotificationPreferences_screenTit.zh: 这台设备上没有推送通道

profileNotificationPreferences_screenTit.en: Notification permission denied; this device can't get push
profileNotificationPreferences_screenTit.zh: 通知权限已拒绝，这台设备收不到推送

profileNotificationPreferences_screenTit.en: Waiting for the system to assign a push channel
profileNotificationPreferences_screenTit.zh: 正在等待系统分配推送通道
这台设备还没有登记成功

profileNotificationPreferences_screenTit.en: This account can't change notification settings
profileNotificationPreferences_screenTit.zh: 当前账号无权修改通知设置
